data.value: Patterns: * matches any text and ? matches one character. Repeated --table, comma lists, and !history* negation are supported.

data.name: HelpPassword
data.value: PostgreSQL and SQL Server passwords are requested once, protected with DPAPI, and never passed to the job. SQLite has no credentials.

data.name: HelpSsl
data.value: PostgreSQL and SQL Server use encrypted connections by default. Use --no-encrypt only for a trusted local development server without SSL.

data.name: HelpTask
data.value: For Task Scheduler, use --scope user with the same account or --scope machine.

data.name: HelpLanguage
data.value: Language: --lang en | --lang es, or set DBFSYNC_LANG.

data.name: HelpSamples
data.value: Run 'dbfsync sample' for complete execution examples.

data.name: SampleSqliteDescription
data.value: The profile creates the local file; migrate loads it initially and sync keeps it current without credentials.

data.name: SampleSqliteCommand
data.value: dbfsync profile set local --engine sqlite --file C:\DBFSync\erp.db dbfsync migrate --profile local --source C:\ERP\Data --all dbfsync sync --profile local --source C:\ERP\Data --all --sync-schema

data.name: SamplePostgresTitle
data.value: 2. Create a database and save a PostgreSQL profile

data.name: SamplePostgresDescription
data.value: If needed, the database is created through postgres; the password is stored with DPAPI. For a trusted local server without SSL, add --no-encrypt.

data.name: SamplePostgresCommand
data.value: dbfsync profile set erp-pg --engine postgresql --server pg01 --port 5432 --database erp --schema public --user dbfsync --scope user --create-database # Local development only, when PostgreSQL has no SSL: dbfsync profile set erp-local --engine postgresql --server 127.0.0.1 --port 5432 --database pwerp --schema public --user postgres --scope user --no-encrypt --create-database

data.name: SampleSqlServerTitle
data.value: 3. Save a SQL Server profile for a scheduled task

data.name: SampleSqlServerDescription
data.value: Machine scope supports a task account on the same server. Restrict access to profiles.json.

data.name: SampleSqlServerCommand
data.value: dbfsync profile set erp-sql --engine sqlserver --server sql01 --database ERP --schema dbo --user dbfsync --scope machine --trust-server-certificate

data.name: SampleIntegratedDescription
data.value: No database password is saved; the process identity is used.

data.name: SampleIntegratedCommand
data.value: dbfsync profile set erp-windows --engine sqlserver --server sql01 --database ERP --integrated

data.name: SampleInspectDescription
data.value: Select invoice and bank movement DBFs, excluding history and backup files.

data.name: SampleMigrateDescription
data.value: Creates missing destination tables and replaces their content.

data.name: SampleSchemaSyncDescription
data.value: Adds missing columns and widens compatible text, decimal, or date types in the same data transaction.

data.name: SampleSchemaDropTitle
data.value: 8. Remove destination columns no longer present in DBF

data.name: SampleSchemaDropDescription
data.value: This is destructive and requires both explicit schema flags.

data.name: SampleRecreateTitle
data.value: 9. Rebuild tables after an incompatible DBF schema change

data.name: SampleRecreateDescription
data.value: --recreate drops and rebuilds the selected destination tables inside a transaction.

data.name: SampleSyncDescription
data.value: The job passes only a profile name; it never includes the database password.

data.name: SampleAllTitle
data.value: 11. Synchronize all DBFs except temporary files

data.name: SampleAllDescription
data.value: --all can be combined with one or more exclusion patterns.

data.name: SampleDatabaseTitle
data.value: 12. Ensure a saved profile's database exists

data.name: SampleDatabaseDescription
data.value: Connects through postgres or master; for SQLite it creates the file and parent directory.

data.name: SampleLanguageDescription
data.value: --lang can appear anywhere. DBFSYNC_LANG defines the default for scheduled tasks.
